A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work, Unifying Deep Stochastic Processes for Image Enhancement. Their main text, equations, 16 tables, nine figures, and Appendices A-G are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original controlled image-enhancement experiments in Section 3, Table 2, and the appendices, including benchmark results and temperature, sampler, and backbone analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, numerical results, analyses, and qualitative image comparisons in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Table 1 retain the same unified SDE framework, method definitions, objectives, and generation procedures. The added citations and proof-source footnote do not alter any method component.

E1.justification: Both retain FFHQ and DIV2K super-resolution, LOL low-light enhancement, ImageNet colorization, and deraining. No dataset or test scenario changes; the Rain1400/Rain100H naming inconsistency between the prose and Table 4 also persists.

E2.justification: The same 11 methods participate in the corresponding benchmark comparisons, and Tables 13-14 retain the same sampler alternatives. The newly cited works are not added experimental comparators.

E3.justification: Section 3.1, Appendix D, and Tables 3-4 retain the same splits, preprocessing, architectures, training budgets, metrics, and experimental configurations. The reported NFE settings and testing procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Temperature and collinearity analyses, backbone and original-configuration comparisons, sampler studies, discretization experiments, and qualitative examples are retained unchanged, including Figures 3-9 and Tables 11-16.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point estimates and aggregation procedures, including Tables 10 and 15. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests; uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 2 and appendix Tables 5-16 retain identical numerical entries and findings, while the plotted results and image examples also match. For example, Table 2 reports the same DM-VP FFHQ results at NFE 35: 27.86 PSNR, 0.748 SSIM, and 0.181 LPIPS.

T1.justification: The equations, propositions, proofs, and scheduler derivations in Section 2 and Appendices A-B are unchanged. v2 adds a footnote pointing to Appendix H of Zhang and Chen (2021) for an existing result; it supplies no new proof or mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: SDE unification, controlled comparison, identification of performance-limiting design choices, and ItoVision. The claim that no method consistently dominates remains unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of low-temperature collinearity, inference errors, deterministic bridge oversmoothing, endpoint regularization, and backbone effects are unchanged. The study's scope exclusions and the substance of the ethical/impact statement are also retained.

D1.justification: New acknowledgments identify the Wroclaw Centre for Networking and Supercomputing and its allocation grant as computing-resource provenance. This is a limited disclosure addition; implementation settings and library installation/access information in Appendices C-D remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Geng et al. (2026) to the flow-matching discussion, Hu et al. (2025) among excluded architecture/sampler work, and Albergo et al. (2025) as related unification work. These additions modestly expand research context without redefining the contribution.

P1.justification: v2 replaces Literatura and Dowód with References and Proof, renames Ethical Statement to Impact Statement, and adds acknowledgments and a proof-source footnote. Author-name text and hyphenation receive small edits; the narrative otherwise remains intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves from page 6 to page 7, accompanied by text reflow and shifted page breaks. The table structures and figure content remain unchanged, with no added or removed visualizations.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves scholarly context and traceability through additional related-work references and an explicit proof-source pointer. English headings and computing acknowledgments improve presentation and disclosure. The methods, derivations, and empirical evidence remain unchanged, so the overall quality gain is limited.
